meta.source: OCI_PaaSIaaS_PriceList_20260611.pdf (Oracle PaaS/IaaS Global Price List, 11 Jun 2026)
meta.purpose: Per-unit OCI rates for the services the cloud-bill mapping resolves to, so a source-cloud usage quantity can be re-priced on OCI (e.g. GB of S3 -> same GB on OCI Object Storage). Rates are pay-as-you-go / metered. Keyed by the ociProduct names used in service_mapping.json.
meta.usageBasis: storage = usage quantity treated as GB-month; transfer = GB; count = per-unit/month
